components.vision: native Qwen3.5 vision transformer, 12 layers, width 768, patch 16
components.merger: native Qwen spatial merger, merge size 2, output 1024; pretrained jointly with vision and language
components.action_head: original L1RegressionActionHead, two MLPResNet blocks, hidden width 4096
components.normalization: shared sealed LIBERO+ training normalization; environment adapter denormalizes

removed_from_student: OpenVLA initial weights and image processor

adaptation.vision_positions: native Qwen image placeholders and multimodal RoPE; AVA weights only on actual image-token positions
adaptation.image_budget: square current cameras, 256px -> 16x16 raw patches -> 8x8 merged tokens
adaptation.batching: unpadded equal-length prompts; two current camera grids per sample; explicit same-episode recurrent state
adaptation.research_scope: vision and language backbone replacement; no longer an LLM-only controlled substitution

initialization.backbone: hfasset://qwen_initial, full native vision/merger/language at one pinned revision
initialization.trainable_new_modules: AVA, proprio projector and L1 action head; native merger is not reinitialized
